items.title: Warner Bros. Discovery earnings, jobless claims: What to Watch
items.summary: Asking for a Trend Host Josh Lipton previews several of the biggest stories to come Thursday, August 6, including earnings out from ConocoPhillips (COP), Warner Bros. Discovery (WBD), and Airbnb (ABNB), as well as key labor data in the form of initial jobless claims.

items.title: ABNB Stock Soars 11% After-Hours — Airbnb Raises 2026 Outlook Again On Strong Travel Demand
items.summary: Airbnb Inc. boosted its 2026 financial outlook after posting strong second-quarter earnings, powered by accelerating booking momentum in major markets across North America and Europe.

items.title: Airbnb Boosts Full-Year Forecast on Strong Demand as AI Bets Pay Off
items.summary: The short-term-rental company said it now expects revenue to increase by at least a mid-teens rate this year, up from its prior projection for growth in the low- to mid-teens.

items.title: Airbnb's CFO Sells Nearly 4,000 Shares Worth About $575,000. Here's What That Means for Investors.
items.summary: This travel provider of an online accommodations marketplace reported a notable insider sale amid an 18% return in its stock price over the past 12 months.

items.title: Airbnb (NASDAQ:ABNB) Surprises With Q2 CY2026 Sales, Stock Soars
items.summary: Online accommodations platform Airbnb (NASDAQ:ABNB) beat Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q2 CY2026, with sales up 16.5% year on year to $3.61 billion. Its GAAP profit of $1.37 per share was 9.5% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
